title: Implement source-map resolver

scope.assurance_scope: PCSM Python v1 source-map resolver capability assessment for the exact current admitted source forest
scope.implementation_delta: No PCSM SourceMapResolver@1, SourceLinkReceipt@1, aggregate current-forest source-map CID, or resolver-specific test module exists in the exact admitted source forest. The nearest reusable components are PythonASTExtractor._SourceMap, which deterministically maps one supplied Python source byte string to AST spans bound to its source CID, and proof_context.build_context_pack, which carries caller-supplied source CIDs and rejects stale/unavailable inputs. Neither resolves alias to canonical CID to an exact current-tree file/node/span map, nor emits a SourceLinkReceipt. The implementation directory is outside this dispatch's exact write authority, so this receipt records the typed unavailable disposition rather than introducing an unreviewed competing resolver.
scope.non_promotion_reason: The required proof_context suite passes only in the provider environment, which is simulated evidence. In the authoritative sealed Python 3.12 environment pytest aborts before collection because its explicitly configured anyio pytest plugin is unavailable; no sealed passing result is claimed.

python_ast_source_span_component.identity_binding: ASTRecord binds source provenance CID, path, repository_id, revision, source spans, frontend, and schema metadata. Source spans are half-open UTF-8 byte intervals with one-based lines and zero-based columns.
deterministic_properties: absolute byte offsets derive from UTF-8 source lines and CPython AST byte columns
canonical ASTRecord serialization and CID verification are strict
the examined source is parsed and never imported or executed
python_ast_source_span_component.rejection_reason: It maps a single caller-supplied source byte string. It does not resolve aliases, enumerate/bind the current source forest, verify current file CIDs against a base tree, select a mutable node/span, or emit SourceLinkReceipt@1.

properties: derives a deterministic ContextPack CID from caller-provided source CIDs and tree OIDs
rejects unavailable inputs, stale freshness, and opaque content without an exact scanned tree
proof_context_component.rejection_reason: It carries three caller-supplied source CIDs for context sufficiency. It neither produces a source map nor resolves a canonical identity to current file/node/span, and it is not SourceLinkReceipt@1.

limitations: This task is receipt-only: it assesses and selects existing components without mutating proof_context or creating a competing resolver authority.
PythonASTExtractor spans bind only the exact source bytes supplied to it. They do not bind an alias to a canonical PCSM identity or establish that a file/node/span remains current in a source forest.
ContextPack source CIDs and freshness flags are caller-supplied context sufficiency inputs, not an aggregate source map or source-link receipt.
The authoritative sealed validation environment lacks anyio, so this receipt cannot promote completion despite the provider-side suite passing.
The receipt has no immutable self-CID because minting a self-describing CID would change its bytes.
